question: The Hundru Fall lies along the course of which of the following rivers?
solution:
The correct answer is __Subarnarekha River__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Subarnarekha** is a rain-fed river flowing in the eastern part of India.
 
• It flows in the state of Jharkhand, West Bengal, and Orissa.
 
• It originates near Nagri village in the Ranchi district.
